import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive analysis
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette for survival
survival_palette = {0: '#e74c3c', 1: '#2ecc71'}
survival_labels = {0: 'Did Not Survive', 1: 'Survived'}

# Plot 1: Survival rate by passenger class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_by_class_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#3498db', '#e91e63'], edgecolor='black')
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'], rotation=0)
ax1.legend(title='Sex', loc='upper right')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)
for container in ax1.containers:
    ax1.bar_label(container, fmt='%.2f', fontsize=8)

# Plot 2: Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for survived in [0, 1]:
    subset = df[df['survived'] == survived]['age'].dropna()
    ax2.hist(subset, bins=30, alpha=0.6, label=survival_labels[survived], 
             color=survival_palette[survived], edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(title='Survival Status')

# Plot 3: Fare distribution by class with survival indication
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
df_valid_fare = df[df['fare'] < 300]  # Remove outliers for better visualization
sns.boxplot(data=df_valid_fare, x='pclass', y='fare', hue='survived', 
            palette=survival_palette, ax=ax3)
ax3.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'])
handles, labels = ax3.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax3.legend(handles, [survival_labels[int(l)] for l in labels], title='Survival Status')

# Plot 4: Survival by embarkation town
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
embark_survival = df.groupby('embark_town').agg({
    'survived': ['sum', 'count']
}).reset_index()
embark_survival.columns = ['embark_town', 'survived', 'total']
embark_survival['died'] = embark_survival['total'] - embark_survival['survived']
embark_survival = embark_survival.dropna()

x = range(len(embark_survival))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax4.bar([i - width/2 for i in x], embark_survival['survived'], width, 
                label='Survived', color='#2ecc71', edgecolor='black')
bars2 = ax4.bar([i + width/2 for i in x], embark_survival['died'], width, 
                label='Did Not Survive', color='#e74c3c', edgecolor='black')
ax4.set_title('Survival Count by Embarkation Town', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Embarkation Town', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xticks(x)
ax4.set_xticklabels(embark_survival['embark_town'])
ax4.legend(title='Survival Status')
ax4.bar_label(bars1, fontsize=8)
ax4.bar_label(bars2, fontsize=8)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
